name: KareKano Trial ~Toki o Kakeru Tokimeki Daisakusen♪~
original_name: カレカノトライアル～時をかけるときめき大作戦♪～
source: "From now on, as a trial, Senpai, you'll be going on a date with me!" This game is a fully voiced coming-of-age adventure game depicting the relationship between Sakuragi Momoka, the basketball team manager who has a crush on the boy, and Enomoto Kaito, the team captain.
